untrustedWorkspaces.description: OzBridge spawns the Oz CLI configured by the workspace via .warp/warp-bridge.yaml. In an untrusted workspace these workspace-scoped settings are ignored and only user/global configuration is honored; the CLI is still spawned from the user's PATH or globally configured ozPath.

virtualWorkspaces.description: OzBridge requires a local Oz CLI binary to spawn agent processes; virtual filesystems (e.g. vscode.dev, github.dev) are not supported.

languageModelTools.name: oz_run_local
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a Warp Oz agent locally in the current VS Code workspace and returns its output. Use when the user asks to execute, refactor, test, or debug code using Warp without consuming cloud credits. Automatically injects IDE context (workspace path, active file, selection, diagnostics) unless `includeIdeContext: false` is passed.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let Copilot invoke Warp Oz agents locally without typing @oz.

prompt.description: Natural-language instruction for the Oz agent.

model.description: Optional AI model override (e.g. `gpt-4o`). Defaults to `ozBridge.defaultModel`.

profile.description: Optional Oz agent profile name. Defaults to `ozBridge.defaultProfile`.

skill.description: Optional agent skill id (e.g. `5-test-agent`). If omitted the CLI picks one based on the prompt.

includeIdeContext.description: Whether to inject workspace/file/selection/diagnostics as a [CONTEXT] prefix. Defaults to true.

languageModelTools.name: oz_run_cloud
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Launches a Warp Oz agent in the cloud. CONSUMES WARP CREDITS — always ask the user for confirmation before invoking. By default waits for the run to reach a terminal status (SUCCEEDED or FAILED) and returns the final output; pass `wait: false` to return immediately with the run id, which the agent can later query via `oz_get_run`.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let Copilot launch cloud Warp Oz runs (with explicit confirmation to consume credits).

prompt.description: Natural-language instruction for the Oz cloud agent.

model.description: Optional AI model override. Defaults to `ozBridge.defaultModel`.

environment.description: Optional cloud environment name or id. Defaults to `ozBridge.defaultEnvironment`; if both are empty the extension auto-picks the first available environment.

includeIdeContext.description: Whether to inject IDE context as a [CONTEXT] prefix. Defaults to true.

wait.description: Whether to poll the run until it reaches a terminal state. Defaults to true.

languageModelTools.name: oz_get_run
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetches the status and output of a Warp Oz run by its id. Read-only; safe to invoke without confirmation. Use it after `oz_run_cloud` with `wait: false`, or when the user references a run id.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up a Warp Oz run by id.

runId.description: Warp run identifier (as returned by `oz_run_cloud`, `oz_list_runs`, or the Warp UI).

languageModelTools.name: oz_list_runs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists recent Warp Oz runs. Supports filters: `all` (default), `active` (QUEUED + INPROGRESS), `completed` (SUCCEEDED + FAILED), or a specific `OzRunStatus` value. Read-only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List recent Warp Oz runs with an optional status filter.

status.description: Filter by status. `active` = QUEUED or INPROGRESS. `completed` = SUCCEEDED or FAILED.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return after filtering.

ozBridge.ozPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Oz CLI executable. Use the bare name `oz` to resolve from `PATH`, or an absolute path like `/usr/local/bin/oz` to pin a specific binary. See [Warp downloads](https://www.warp.dev/download).

ozBridge.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Default AI model for agent runs. Use `auto` to let Warp pick the best available model, or pin a specific id (e.g. `claude-3-7-sonnet`, `gpt-4o`).

ozBridge.defaultProfile.markdownDescription: Default Oz agent profile. Profiles are managed by the Warp app under **Settings → AI → Profiles**.

ozBridge.defaultEnvironment.markdownDescription: Default cloud environment id (empty = let Warp pick the first available, or run with no environment if none exist).

ozBridge.cloudPollingIntervalMs.markdownDescription: Initial polling interval for cloud runs (in **milliseconds**). The poller backs off exponentially from this value.

ozBridge.cloudPollingTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Maximum polling duration for cloud runs (in **milliseconds**). Default `1800000` = 30 minutes.

ozBridge.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout for local agent runs (in **milliseconds**). Default `300000` = 5 minutes.

ozBridge.idleTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Idle timeout for the Oz CLI subprocess (in **milliseconds**). Aborts the run if no `stdout` / `stderr` is received for this long — prevents 5-minute hangs when Warp is silently unresponsive (e.g. depleted credits, network outage). Set to `0` to disable. Default `90000` = 90 s.

ozBridge.maxOutputChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters streamed back to chat before truncation. Larger values consume more context budget on the LM side.

ozBridge.mcpEnabled.markdownDescription: Start an embedded MCP server at activation so **Claude Code**, **Cursor** and **Codex** can drive Oz. See [`docs/MCP.md`](https://github.com/sena-labs/OzBridge/blob/main/docs/MCP.md).

ozBridge.mcpPort.markdownDescription: TCP port the MCP server listens on when enabled. Set to `0` to let the OS allocate an ephemeral port.

ozBridge.mcpMaxSseSessions.markdownDescription: Maximum number of concurrent MCP SSE sessions. Additional `GET /sse` requests are rejected with **HTTP 503** once the cap is reached.

ozBridge.mcpSseMaxLifetimeMs.markdownDescription: Maximum lifetime for a single MCP SSE session (in **milliseconds**). When reached the server closes the connection and frees its timers/socket, preventing resource leaks from clients that never disconnect. Clamped to `[60000, 86400000]` (1 minute – 24 hours); out-of-range values fall back to the default. Default `1800000` = 30 minutes.

ozBridge.mcpBindAddress.markdownDescription: Network interface the MCP server binds to. Keep `127.0.0.1` unless you explicitly want to expose the server to other hosts. Setting `0.0.0.0` exposes it to the entire network — always pair with `#ozBridge.mcpBearerToken#`.

ozBridge.mcpBearerToken.markdownDescription: Optional bearer token required on every MCP request. Empty string disables auth. Set via **Settings** or `settings.json`.

ozBridge.telemetry.connectionString.markdownDescription: Application Insights connection string (`InstrumentationKey=...;IngestionEndpoint=...`) for opt-in telemetry. Empty string keeps the transport disabled even when VS Code's `telemetry.telemetryLevel` is on. See [`PRIVACY.md`](https://github.com/sena-labs/OzBridge/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) for what is and isn't collected.

ozBridge.killSwitch.enabled.markdownDescription: **Emergency kill-switch.** When `true`, the extension's `activate()` skips every wiring step (no commands, tools, MCP server, chat participant or trees are registered) and surfaces a single warning notification. Use only as an operator escape hatch for a critical regression or a supply-chain incident. See [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/sena-labs/OzBridge/blob/main/SECURITY.md#kill-switch-v10-deliverable-t) for the policy.

ozBridge.killSwitch.reason.markdownDescription: Optional message displayed in the kill-switch notification (e.g. an incident URL). Ignored unless `#ozBridge.killSwitch.enabled#` is `true`.
